prompt: Jia wants to ask the artist a question, but does not need to see the studio. Which plan works on either a calm or a windy evening?
promptZh: 佳想問藝術家一個問題，但不一定要看工作室。不論風勢平穩或有強風，哪種安排都可行？

options.text: On a calm night, take the long route to the studio; in strong wind, stay with the group until the last sculpture.
options.zh: 風勢平穩時走長線到工作室；強風時跟團走到最後一座雕塑。
options.whyZh: 平常經過工作室的只有長線；強風時藝術家改在短線最後一座雕塑回答問題。

options.text: On a calm night, take the short route to the studio; in strong wind, stay with the group until the last sculpture.
options.zh: 風勢平穩時走短線到工作室；強風時跟團走到最後一座雕塑。
options.whyZh: 強風部分正確，但風勢平穩時短線不經過工作室。

options.text: On a calm night, take the long route to the studio; in strong wind, wait for the artist at the projection.
options.zh: 風勢平穩時走長線到工作室；強風時在投影處等藝術家。
options.whyZh: 風勢平穩部分正確；強風時投影仍會舉行，但問答是改到最後一座雕塑。

options.text: On a calm night, wait by the ramp; in strong wind, go to the studio.
options.zh: 風勢平穩時在坡道旁等；強風時去工作室。
options.whyZh: 坡道是短線的一部分；強風時問答不在工作室。

explanationZh: 平常經過工作室的只有長線；強風時藝術家改在短線最後一座雕塑回答問題。
evidence: Only the long route stops at the artist’s studio for questions before it closes to visitors at 7:30. / the artist will answer questions at the last sculpture instead of at the studio. / The theater projection will still happen.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Only the long route stops at the artist’s studio for questions before it closes to visitors at 7:30.
the artist will answer questions at the last sculpture instead of at the studio.
The theater projection will still happen.

vocabulary.note: 用來指出原來位置或做法被另一個替代。
